model: Original H3-World 33B + released action LoRA; frozen for teacher

native_conditioning.image: one native process_image=True RGB I0 anchor from each selected PNG
native_conditioning.action: synthetic counterfactual A and D, each spanning native latent action rows
native_conditioning.audio: native audio noise, no extra audio condition
native_conditioning.future_action_rows: physically trim beyond visible chunk before each DiT call
native_conditioning.routing: own-action Single-Egress + action feedback + current non-action prefix feedback
native_conditioning.attention: strict chunk-causal video, Global RoPE, native video sigma/audio=1000
native_conditioning.cache: 50-layer CPU raw KV; clean sigma=0 commit; each model rebuilds its own cache
native_conditioning.history: student or teacher generated; no GT reset

proposed_encoding.input_noise: new full37 native initial video/audio noise per scene from seed13

proposed_frozen_teacher.C1: FM30 under action A for 12 latent / 39 RGB frames
proposed_frozen_teacher.C2: fork A and D on same generated clean C1; each FM30 for 5 latent / 17 new RGB frames
proposed_frozen_teacher.training_target: teacher generated C2 endpoint for A/D; never relabel real ABot clip as pure A/D

proposed_student.initialization: new V3-initialized target-time + tail8 rank8 QKV student, independent of AF2 step32
proposed_student.objective: TF-AnyFlow finite map: 2 diagonal/FM + 1 endpoint + 1 general interval per logical batch4
proposed_student.episode_balance: one sample from each of four train episodes per update; eight-step Latin schedule balances A/D and the four sample types
proposed_student.training_C1_latent_source: immutable frozen V3 FM30 teacher-generated C1 endpoint for that episode; do not resample student C1 each update
proposed_student.history: commit the same frozen teacher C1 latent with the current student weights to rebuild that episode's sigma=0 raw KV after every optimizer update; detach
proposed_student.checkpoint: one fixed final checkpoint only; no validation checkpoint selection

fixed_validation.label: previously observed regression set, not blind held-out test
fixed_validation.additional_regression: frozen parking lot single-scene reference; source episode relationship to ABot not proven
fixed_validation.fm8_reference: reuse matched EXP-011 industrial/village C1+C2 and EXP-006 parking C1+C2 after source/noise/protocol SHA checks; do not rerun without a documented mismatch
comparisons: FM8 vs AnyFlow8 on a shared frozen C1 generated history, each model's own KV
FM8 vs AnyFlow8 from each model's own C1 through C2
fixed_validation.video_gate: actual action direction and subject/environment structure, not finite-map loss alone
